test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(11, 23, 47)
solution:
The pattern in the given set is:

 **Difference between 1st and 2ⁿd term × 2 = Difference between 2ⁿd and 3rd term**

Let's apply:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41eac87ed92eb5f95595c9b0b9243d970ff9119a274b26c842775839e44221d6.png] 12 × 2 = 24 

Now we compare the pattern with the given options:

Option 1) (17, 35, 69) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2157f7193619f524388639e9c13f40d12a1fd784206f71b6c37ddced63149290.png] 18 × 2 = 36 ; 34 ≠ 36 

Option 2) (13, 27, 54) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cdc872bb9433c276a846eca195e3f63d2e88344d38800222543599349dfe5d3.png] 14 × 2 = 28 ; 27 ≠ 28 

Option 3) (19, 39, 79) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/456261f284ce4be7622afa7e4505632c34a0340faad7e52d4546245ce521859b.png] 20 × 2 = 40 ; 40 = 40 

Option 4) (23, 46, 93) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5b11de142841b826ebce236364e3e7352cfc763169077f4b224a232a69ec890.png] 23 × 2 = 46 ; 46 ≠ 47 

Only option 3) matches the pattern of the given set.

**Hence,** **the correct answer is option 3.**
